title: IKEA SKÅDIS – Double-Shelf Organizer
author: itsErik
description:
Boost Me (for free)

Hello! I'm pretty new to 3D modeling and printing, and I’ve been putting a lot of time, effort and heart into creating and sharing useful designs like this one. Time is precious, so if you like what I made, I’d really appreciate it if you could give it a boost. 😊 Your support means a lot and helps keep me motivated to keep learning and creating. Thank you! 🙏

Boost

This is a simple but super useful **double shelf** designed to fit the **IKEA SKÅDIS** pegboard. It’s sized at _123 x 150 x 70 mm_ and works like a little box - you can stash stuff inside the main shelf _and_ use the top for extra storage. Great for keeping things tidy and within reach. 😁

The sides have a clean hexagonal pattern to cut down on material without losing strength.

It mounts to the board with four hooks for a secure hold. Depending on your SKÅDIS board, the fit might be snug \- you might need to wiggle the hooks a bit to get them in, but once it’s on, it’s not going anywhere. 😉

Perfect for organizing your workspace, craft area, or just clearing up some clutter. 👌
